crs: EPSG:4326 verified GeoPackage; shared local east/south frame for tiles
direction: Source None/Not One-Way permits both directions; 1/Follow-Digitization forward; -1/Against-Digitization reverse. Other pairs excluded.
license_evidence: Official catalogue and CKAN checked 2026-10-31 identify open-government-licence-toronto; older district provenance retains its historical missing metadata.
limits: Cartographic street centrelines projected onto coarse terrain, not road surfaces or correct bridge/tunnel heights. Missing terrain remains missing.
Directed shortest source-length paths are topology experiments, not driving directions or legal/access/turn guidance. No traffic interactions or actor reassignment.
Pending roads, trails, railway, busway, laneways and other classes excluded from this street increment; jurisdiction is not an access guarantee.
Graph excludes inconsistent endpoint IDs and boundary-crossing edges instead of inventing connectivity.
selection: Expressways, ramps, arterials, collectors and local streets intersecting official municipality. Visual lines clipped; graph requires whole single-part edges within boundary, selected City/Province jurisdiction and consistent source intersection endpoints within 0.5 m. No geometric crossing joins, snapping, transfer or inferred connector edges.
